backend_dependency_signals.note: backend dependency categories include database, message broker, cache, payment, email, storage, search and third-party HTTP/provider clients; present_unverified until owner review, contract evidence and runtime verification confirm dependency behavior

backend_delivery_signals.note: Workspace discovery records backend stack, backend commands, CI, APIs, DB, queues, workers, deployment manifests and security signals as present_unverified without executing deployments, commands or external writes; approval_required applies before deployment, production data, secrets or other external mutations.

backend_resilience_signals.note: T9-D7 uses lightweight read-only signals for retry/idempotency terms and dependency/job context only; deeper static analysis deferred to avoid false positives until a later stack-specific slice has owner, examples and verification.

ci_stabilization_signals.note: present_unverified until local reproduction, deterministic/flaky classification, rerun evidence, and owner approval confirm CI behavior

release_packaging_signals.note: present_unverified until release evidence, SemVer review, build and test evidence, docs evidence, security/license review, owner review, publish approval, and rollback evidence confirm readiness

delivery_release_operations_signals.note: present_unverified until release scope, version impact, current release evidence, owner evidence, approval boundary and accepted gaps confirm readiness
